1 /**
2  * Ecgberht engine entrypoint.
3  * W1: closed verbs + pack loaders.
4  * W2: Face+Strip protocol, heal law, A1 discovery, strip-first rank.
5  * W3: closed verb bodies + write-authority enforcement + harness canaries.
6  * W4: dispatch table, LITE bias, structured receipts (override/depth/soft-vet).
7  * W5 (legacy skill-plan): compose-only commission adapters + subscription seating.
8  * Wave 5 (steward-handoff v3): decision records, G2/G3/G5/G6 spikes, cost
9  *      model, deriveCommissionableSkills, SC6 feasibility verdict.
10  * W6: verification pack, Grasscatcher ledger, Stage-2 freeze, canary pack.
11  * TW1: Campaign Roadmap — append-only roadmap_events + derived projection.
12  * TW2: Decision Packet / brief engine — Q1–Q12 deterministic retrieval,
13  *      seen receipt delta anchor, read-only Anchor knowledge, precompute cache.
14  * TW3: Commission propose/confirm + M2 job lifecycle receipts — jobs compose
15  *      Anchor job_runner; queued→running→done|failed|orphaned|reaped;
16  *      commission_abnormal receipt; commission_bind/status_flip via the
17  *      Roadmap single writer. No in-process Foreman/Shark loops.
18  * TW4: Dialogue compile layer (R2 §4.3 v1 act table; refuse-with-proposal;
19  *      ephemeral dialogue store — no durable chat ledger) + seat hop
20  *      (seat_hop receipt who/when/from→to; titlebar switcher wired to
21  *      Anchor prefs claude/gemini/grok; non-event — no re-brief).
22  * TW5: Seal chamber view model (wireframes v2.1 Screen 1) — goal bar ·
23  *      Roadmap rail · ⏱ run block · steward-first conversation, composed
24  *      from the closed verb bodies (CLI parity structural); rendered by the
25  *      Anchor-dev docked overlay mount, never a v1 instrument card sheet.
26  * TW6: High Seat view model (Screens 0+2) — raise queue (R2 §4.5, one raised
27  *      at a time, ⚑ badge = queue length as the only ambient signal), spoken
28  *      capacity balancing (annex A1/A3, override = receipt, no fake meters),
29  *      Bring-it-up in-overlay hop (Option P path passport, cached packet) —
30  *      plus the Decision Packet view (Screen 3): goal card always first,
31  *      exactly one question, artifact display MVP (HTML inline best-effort,
32  *      never a bare path), answers move the Roadmap via the single writer.
33  * TW7: Standing up & honest states (Screen 4) — new-ground chamber (goal
34  *      asked, never invented; Face+Strip created from templates on confirm
35  *      ONLY), capacity-unknown hard-stop (spoken, exactly three honest
36  *      options, no silent FULL, no meters), thin-evidence beat (honest
37  *      unknown + constructive offer) — plus the TW7 canaries: junction
38  *      realpath-before-prefix toward release freezes fails CI, and the
39  *      second-task-DB canary keeps E5 the sole ledger.
40  * TW8: Progressive-enhancement HARD GATE (voice / living animation /
41  *      calendar-email open ONLY on TW5–TW6 spine green — structural probes
42  *      over the shipped chambers — PLUS explicit literal-true config; any
43  *      attempt before the gate refuses) + E7 recorded NOT built: parked
44  *      Roadmap stub steps appended via the TW1 single writer, a refuse for
45  *      any connector use, and the E7 not-built canary (connector marker +
46  *      import/network call in engine sources is a red build — no OAuth code).
47  */

1684 import {
1685   CLOSED_VERBS,
1686   isClosedVerb,
1687   refuseUnknownVerb,
1688   resolvePrimaryVerb,
1689   SPELLING,
1690   VERB_ALIASES,
1691 } from './verbs.mjs';
1692 import { parseRootsFromCliArgs } from './discovery.mjs';
1693 import { parseVerbArgs, runClosedVerbBody } from './verb-bodies.mjs';
1694 
1695 /**
1696  * Run a closed verb body. Unknown verbs → structured refuse (no plugin dispatch).
1697  * @param {string} verb
1698  * @param {string[]} [args]
1699  * @param {object} [inject] test injectors (surfaces, cwd, persist, env, …)
1700  * @returns {object}
1701  */
1702 export function runVerb(verb, args = [], inject = {}) {
1703   if (!isClosedVerb(verb)) {
1704     return refuseUnknownVerb(verb);
1705   }
1706 
1707   const primary = resolvePrimaryVerb(verb);
1708   const parsed = parseVerbArgs(Array.isArray(args) ? args : []);
1709   const cli = parseRootsFromCliArgs(Array.isArray(args) ? args : []);
1710 
1711   // Merge CLI roots/project with parseVerbArgs (same tokens)
1712   const roots = parsed.roots.length ? parsed.roots : cli.roots;
1713   const project = parsed.project ?? cli.project;
1714 
1715   const opts = {
1716     ...parsed,
1717     roots,
1718     project,
1719     verb_name: verb,
1720     // Alias original argv name for update vs heartbeat / soft-vet vs grasscatch
1721     ...(VERB_ALIASES[verb] ? { verb_name: verb } : {}),
1722     ...inject,
1723   };
1724 
1725   // Prefer inject.roots / inject.project when provided
1726   if (inject.roots !== undefined) opts.roots = inject.roots;
1727   if (inject.project !== undefined) opts.project = inject.project;
1728 
1729   const body = runClosedVerbBody(primary, opts);
1730   // Ensure verb field reflects the invoked token (including aliases)
1731   if (body && typeof body === 'object' && body.verb == null) {
1732     body.verb = verb;
1733   } else if (body && typeof body === 'object') {
1734     body.verb = verb;
1735     body.primary = primary;
1736   }
1737   return body;
1738 }
1739 
1740 /**
1741  * CLI main: verb may lead or follow --roots/--project flags.
1742  * @param {string[]} argv process.argv.slice(2)
1743  * @returns {object}
1744  */
1745 export function main(argv) {
1746   const tokens = Array.isArray(argv) ? argv : [];
1747 
1748   if (!tokens.length) {
1749     return {
1750       ok: false,
1751       error: 'missing_verb',
1752       spelling: SPELLING,
1753       message: `${SPELLING} requires a closed verb. Pass one of the closed list.`,
1754       closed_verbs: [...CLOSED_VERBS],
1755     };
1756   }
1757 
1758   const parsed = parseRootsFromCliArgs(tokens);
1759   // Prefer first non-flag token as verb (supports `status --roots X` and `--roots X status`)
1760   let verb = null;
1761   let verbIndex = -1;
1762   for (let i = 0; i < tokens.length; i++) {
1763     const t = tokens[i];
1764     if (t === '--roots' || t === '-R' || t === '--project' || t === '-p') {
1765       // skip flag and its value
1766       if (tokens[i + 1] && !tokens[i + 1].startsWith('-')) i++;
1767       continue;
1768     }
1769     if (t.startsWith('--roots=') || t.startsWith('--project=')) continue;
1770     // Other long options are not the verb
1771     if (t.startsWith('--') || t.startsWith('-')) {
1772       // value-taking flags already handled for roots/project; skip known pairs generically
1773       if (
1774         tokens[i + 1] &&
1775         !tokens[i + 1].startsWith('-') &&
1776         !t.includes('=')
1777       ) {
1778         // only skip value when this looks like a flag that takes one (heuristic: not boolean)
1779         const booleanFlags = new Set(['--dry-run', '--no-persist']);
1780         if (!booleanFlags.has(t)) i++;
1781       }
1782       continue;
1783     }
1784     verb = t;
1785     verbIndex = i;
1786     break;
1787   }
1788 
1789   if (!verb) {
1790     return {
1791       ok: false,
1792       error: 'missing_verb',
1793       spelling: SPELLING,
1794       message: `${SPELLING} requires a closed verb. Pass one of the closed list.`,
1795       closed_verbs: [...CLOSED_VERBS],
1796       cli_roots: parsed.roots,
1797       cli_project: parsed.project,
1798     };
1799   }
1800 
1801   const args = tokens.filter((_, i) => i !== verbIndex);
1802   return runVerb(verb, args);
1803 }
